mcq.q: What does Bal Kaand tell about?
options: The childhood of Ram and his brothers
The fourteen years in the forest
mcq.explanation: Bal means child.

mcq.q: Who was the king of Ayodhya in the Ramayan?
mcq.explanation: King Dasharatha ruled Ayodhya.

mcq.q: Which of these were sons of King Dasharatha?
mcq.explanation: These were the four brothers.

mcq.q: Who took Ram and Lakshman to protect his forest prayers?
mcq.explanation: Vishwamitra asked for their help.

mcq.q: Whom did Ram marry in the Bal Kaand?
mcq.explanation: Ram married Sita in Mithila.

mcq.q: Which quality of Ram is taught in the Bal Kaand?
mcq.explanation: Ram was truthful, polite and brave.

mcq.q: What is Ayodhya Kaand about?
options: Ram going to the forest and Bharat's humility
mcq.explanation: It tells of Ram's fourteen years away from the kingdom.

mcq.q: For how many years was Ram asked to live in the forest?
mcq.explanation: Kaikeyi asked that Ram go for fourteen years.

mcq.q: Who asked that Bharat be made king?
mcq.explanation: Kaikeyi reminded the king of two promises.

mcq.q: Who went into the forest with Ram?
mcq.explanation: Sita and Lakshman chose to go with him.

mcq.q: What did Bharat place on the throne?
mcq.explanation: Bharat ruled in Ram's name.

mcq.q: What is the lesson of Bharat refusing the throne?
options: Be humble and do not be greedy for power
mcq.explanation: He knew the throne belonged to Ram.

mcq.q: What promise lesson do we learn from the Ayodhya Kaand?
mcq.explanation: Ram kept his father's promise.

mcq.q: Which scripture is a Jain book about the life of Lord Mahavir?
mcq.explanation: The Kalpasutra tells the life of Lord Mahavir.

mcq.q: During which Jain festival is the Kalpasutra often read?
mcq.explanation: Many Jains listen to it during Paryushan.

mcq.q: Which Jain scripture gives advice on a disciplined life?
mcq.explanation: It teaches Ahimsa, truth and control of anger.

mcq.q: Which is a main message of Jain scriptures?
mcq.explanation: Ahimsa is central in Jainism.

mcq.q: Which faith does the Dhammapada belong to?
mcq.explanation: It is a collection of Buddhist verses.

mcq.q: What is the Dhammapada?
options: A book of wise sayings and verses
A long story of a king
mcq.explanation: It teaches how to live wisely.

mcq.q: According to the Dhammapada teachings in the lesson, hatred is ended by what?
mcq.explanation: Hatred is not ended by hatred but by love.

mcq.q: Who gave the Sigalovada Sutta talk?
mcq.explanation: The Buddha spoke to a young man named Sigala.

mcq.q: Who was Sigala?
options: A young man taught by the Buddha
mcq.explanation: The talk was given to him.

mcq.q: How many directions (groups of people) does the Sigalovada Sutta list?
mcq.explanation: It lists six groups.

mcq.q: Which of these is one of the six directions in the Sigalovada Sutta?
mcq.explanation: Parents, teachers, family, friends, workers and holy teachers.

mcq.q: Which of the Sigalovada teachings shows how to treat the people who help us at home or work?
options: Respect and care for workers and helpers
mcq.explanation: Workers are one of the six directions.

mcq.q: What is the holy scripture of the Sikhs?
mcq.explanation: Sikhs follow it as their eternal Guru.

mcq.q: Who first compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji?
mcq.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji was the fifth Guru.

mcq.q: Who declared that Sikhs should follow the Granth as their Guru?
mcq.explanation: He was the tenth Guru.

mcq.q: In which script is Guru Granth Sahib Ji written?
mcq.explanation: It is written in Gurmukhi.

mcq.q: What does Ik Onkar stand for?
mcq.explanation: Ik Onkar means One God.

mcq.q: Whose hymns are also in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji?
options: Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
mcq.explanation: It includes holy men of other traditions.

mcq.q: What do Sikhs eat together in the gurdwara?
mcq.explanation: Everyone eats together in the langar.

mcq.q: What does the langar teach?
mcq.explanation: Everyone sits side by side to eat.

mcq.q: How should we treat a scripture?
mcq.explanation: Scriptures are kept clean and high.

mcq.q: How can you learn more about scriptures?
options: Listen to a resource person or visit a library
mcq.explanation: We can listen, read and discuss.

mcq.q: Which is a mistake about scriptures?
options: Making fun of another faith's holy book
mcq.explanation: We should respect all scriptures.

mcq.q: Which pair is correct?
mcq.explanation: The Uttaradhyayan Sutra is a Jain scripture.

mcq.q: A child promises to return a friend's book on time. Which scripture lesson is being followed?
options: Keeping a promise, as in the Ramayan
mcq.explanation: Ram kept promises.

mcq.q: Which action follows the Jain teaching of gentleness?
options: Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
mcq.explanation: Gentleness to living things is central.

mcq.q: Which action follows a Sikh teaching?
options: Sharing lunch with someone who has none
mcq.explanation: Sharing with others is a Sikh teaching.

mcq.q: What does Dainik mean?
mcq.explanation: Dainik means daily.

mcq.q: What is a prayer?
options: A way of talking to God
mcq.explanation: We thank God and ask for wisdom.

mcq.q: Which is a benefit of praying every day?
mcq.explanation: Doing it regularly teaches discipline.

mcq.q: From which Veda does the Gayatri Mantra come?
mcq.explanation: The Gayatri Mantra comes from the Rig Veda.

mcq.q: What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for?
mcq.explanation: It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

mcq.q: What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to?
mcq.explanation: Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

mcq.q: Which is the first line of the Gayatri Mantra?
mcq.explanation: The Gayatri Mantra begins Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah.

mcq.q: How should we say the Gayatri Mantra?
mcq.explanation: Calm and clear.

mcq.q: When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say?
mcq.explanation: It is a prayer for wisdom.

mcq.q: Which prayer starts with the words Twameva mata cha pita twameva?
mcq.explanation: It begins with these words.

mcq.q: In Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva, whom does the prayer speak to?
mcq.explanation: It speaks to God as parent and friend.

mcq.q: What does mata mean in the prayer?
mcq.explanation: Mata means mother and pita means father.

mcq.q: What does pita mean in the prayer?
mcq.explanation: Pita means father.

mcq.q: What does sakha mean in the prayer?
mcq.explanation: Sakha means friend.

mcq.q: What does vidya mean in the prayer?
mcq.explanation: Vidya is knowledge.

mcq.q: What does dravinam mean in the prayer?
mcq.explanation: Dravinam means wealth.

mcq.q: When can Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva be said?
options: Before meals and in the evening
mcq.explanation: It is said before meals, at assembly and in the evening.

mcq.q: What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God?
options: God cares for us like a parent and friend
mcq.explanation: God is called our mother, father and friend.

mcq.q: Which goddess is Saraswati?
mcq.explanation: Saraswati is the goddess of learning.

mcq.q: What does Vandana mean?
options: An act of respect and prayer
mcq.explanation: Vandana is respectful prayer.

mcq.q: What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures?
mcq.explanation: The veena and the book.

mcq.q: What does the veena stand for?
mcq.explanation: It is a musical instrument.

mcq.q: What does the book stand for?
mcq.explanation: The book stands for knowledge.

mcq.q: What does the white colour of Saraswati stand for?
mcq.explanation: White is a sign of purity.

mcq.q: On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati?
mcq.explanation: Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

mcq.q: Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana?
mcq.explanation: This is the opening line.

mcq.q: Which of these should you do first when learning a mantra?
options: Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
mcq.explanation: Listening helps us say the right sounds.

mcq.q: What is a good posture for prayer?
mcq.explanation: Calm sitting is respectful.

mcq.q: What greeting shows respect with folded hands?
mcq.explanation: Namaste is done with folded hands.

mcq.q: Which is a bad habit during prayer?
mcq.explanation: We should be quiet and respectful.

mcq.q: What is a Mandir?
mcq.explanation: A Mandir is a Hindu temple.

mcq.q: What is the murti in a Mandir?
mcq.explanation: The murti is a statue or image of God.

mcq.q: What is the garbhagriha?
options: The inner room where the murti is placed
mcq.explanation: It is the inner sanctum.

mcq.q: What is the shikhara?
options: The spire above the inner room
mcq.explanation: It is the spire or dome.

mcq.q: What is aarti?
options: Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
mcq.explanation: It is a prayer with a lamp.

mcq.q: What is prasad?
mcq.explanation: Prasad is blessed food.

mcq.q: What is darshan?
options: Looking at the murti with respect
mcq.explanation: Darshan is a respectful sight of God.

mcq.q: What are bhajans?
mcq.explanation: Bhajans are songs of prayer.

mcq.q: What should you do with your shoes before entering a Mandir?
mcq.explanation: Shoes are removed to keep it clean and show respect.

mcq.q: How should you dress to visit a Mandir?
mcq.explanation: Modest dress shows respect.

mcq.q: What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir?
mcq.explanation: Always ask first.

mcq.q: How should you receive prasad?
options: With your right hand or both hands, and say thank you
mcq.explanation: Receive with politeness.

mcq.q: Which is a typical feature of Mandirs?
options: A bell rung gently on arrival
mcq.explanation: The bell announces arrival.

mcq.q: In which Kenyan towns are Mandirs found?
mcq.explanation: Mandirs are found in many Kenyan towns.

mcq.q: What could you use to map the Mandirs in Kenya?
options: A safe digital map with a teacher's help
mcq.explanation: We can use a map on a tablet.

mcq.q: How can you show a Mandir in a drawing?
options: A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
mcq.explanation: A hall with a spire is a simple model.

mcq.q: How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly?
mcq.explanation: Everyone can take part in their own way.

mcq.q: What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana?
options: To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
mcq.explanation: It asks for a clear mind.

mcq.q: What does Sadachaar mean?
mcq.explanation: Sadachaar is the way a good person behaves.

mcq.q: Which best describes a person with integrity?
options: Honest even when nobody is watching
mcq.explanation: Integrity is honesty at all times.

mcq.q: You find Ksh 100 on the school field. What shows integrity?
options: Give it to the teacher so it can be returned
mcq.explanation: A lost note belongs to its owner.

mcq.q: Which is a sign of integrity?
mcq.explanation: Keeping promises shows honesty.

mcq.q: Which is a benefit of integrity?
mcq.explanation: Honest people are trusted.

mcq.q: Why is integrity compared to a strong wall?
options: One weak brick can make it fall
mcq.explanation: Small lies can weaken trust.

mcq.q: What is a parable?
options: A short story with a lesson
mcq.explanation: A parable teaches a moral.

mcq.q: Which king is known for always telling the truth in a Hindu story?
mcq.explanation: Harishchandra kept his word.

mcq.q: What did King Harishchandra give up rather than break his promise?
mcq.explanation: He gave up his whole kingdom.

mcq.q: What is the lesson of the Harishchandra story?
options: Truth is worth more than wealth or comfort
mcq.explanation: The king chose truth.

mcq.q: Who was Bhai Lalo?
options: An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story
mcq.explanation: Bhai Lalo earned by honest work.

mcq.q: What does Kirat Karni mean?
mcq.explanation: Kirat Karni is honest labour.
